messages:
sara: Heads-up — new enforcement: Azure Key Vault & Service Principal secret policy rolling out. We're deprecating long-lived client secrets and requiring Managed Identity or OIDC workload identity federation for service-to-service auth. Action required by 2026-04-05.

alex: What triggered this now?

sara: A few recent repo findings + a couple of expired, unmonitored app secrets. Rather than ad-hoc rotations we want a platform-level policy: no shared static secrets for SPs. We'll enable a Key Vault access policy + Conditional Access block for legacy auth.

mira: Can you post timeline and concrete steps?

sara: Timeline: enforcement date Apr 5, 2026. Steps: 1) Migrate apps to either Managed Identity (recommended for infra) or workload identity federation (OIDC) for CI runners. 2) Move all secrets into Key Vault with user-assigned identities and RBAC. 3) Remove any client secret from repos and rotate creds immediately. 4) Run the detection script and upload report to the runbook.

jon: Where's the detection script + runbook?

sara: Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/kv-identity-migration (internal). Detection: ./tools/azure-sp-scan --org redwood --output reports/kv-scan-<org>.csv. Quick sample: 
```
az ad sp credential list --id <APP_ID> | jq '.[] | {startDate, endDate, keyId}'
```

devops-bot: Scan queued for org "redwood" — owners will receive DMs with results. Pre-commit hook pushed: ./scripts/check-azure-secrets.sh (will block obvious secret regex matches).

alex: If a team can't finish migration before Apr 5, what's the process?

sara: Short exception window: submit justification to sec@redwood.com. We can grant a 2-week temporary exception with mandatory rotation and elevated audit logging. Exceptions are rare — plan for migration.

mira: I'll host migration office hours next Tue 10:00am PT and drop a calendar invite in #eng.

sara: Thanks — please treat this as high priority. We'll run an org-wide sweep on Apr 6 and start enforcement/blocking legacy auth. If you hit blocked deploys after enforcement, escalate in #eng-security and ping me directly. :lock: :calendar:
